source_data.desc:
Tougher than a typical animated skeleton, these undead are raised from skeletal remains that have fossilized._  
**Bones of Stone.** The swordbreaker skeleton’s bones have fossilized and become stony. Most weapons shatter against these bones, but the fossilization makes the skeletons more susceptible to magic that harms stone or that causes concussive bursts of sound.  
**Undead Nature.** A swordbreaker skeleton doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.
source_data.languages: understands all languages it knew in life but can’t speak
source_data.name: Veteran Swordbreaker Skeleton
source_data.special_abilities_json: [{"name": "Fossilized Bones", "desc": "Any nonmagical slashing or piercing weapon made of metal or wood that hits the swordbreaker skeleton cracks. After dealing damage, the weapon takes a permanent and cumulative -1 penalty to damage rolls. If its penalty drops to -5, the weapon is destroyed. Nonmagical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the swordbreaker skeleton is destroyed after dealing damage."}]

en.description:
Tougher than a typical animated skeleton, these undead are raised from skeletal remains that have fossilized._  
**Bones of Stone.** The swordbreaker skeleton’s bones have fossilized and become stony. Most weapons shatter against these bones, but the fossilization makes the skeletons more susceptible to magic that harms stone or that causes concussive bursts of sound.  
**Undead Nature.** A swordbreaker skeleton doesn’t require air, food, drink, or sleep.
en.name: Veteran Swordbreaker Skeleton

ru.description:
Твёрже, чем типичный оживлённый скелет, эти неживые подняты из скелетных останков, которые окаменели.

**Кости из камня.** Кости скелета-мечелома окаменели и стали каменистыми. Большинство оружия разбивается об эти кости, но окаменение делает скелетов более восприимчивыми к магии, которая вредит камню или которая вызывает сотрясающие всплески звука.

**Природа нежити.** Скелет-мечелом не требует воздуха, пищи, питья или сна.
ru.name: Скелет-ветеран мечелом
